Atyrau Masters: Top two seeds defeated in opening rounds
rubriker._rss_content: The Atyrau Masters in Kazakhstan has attracted a strong international field, with Shamsiddin Vokhidov and Leon Luke Mendonca heading the starting list. Both top seeds suffered unexpected defeats in the opening two rounds, losing to significantly lower-rated opponents. Nguyen Duc Hoa defeated Vokhidov in round one, while Sergey Sklokin-Bagiyan overcame Mendonca in round two. The nine-round Swiss tournament, part of the Kazakhstan Chess Cup, concludes on 20 October. | Photo: Kazakhstan Chess Federation

rubriker.title: Young British prodigies
rubriker._rss_content: The English Chess Federation has congratulated 12-year-old chess prodigy Supratit Banerjee after his International Master title was officially approved by FIDE, making him the youngest English player to achieve the prestigious title. This is another milestone for a remarkable generation of young English chess talent that includes Britain's youngest WGM, 11-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan.

rubriker.title: 6th Intercontinental Online Chess Championship for Prisoners kicks off with record 140 teams
rubriker._rss_content: The 6th Intercontinental Online Chess Championship for Prisoners began on 13 October with a record 140 teams from 56 countries competing across men's, women's and youth sections. Organised by FIDE and the Cook County Sheriff's Office, the three-day event continues a programme that uses chess as an educational and social tool in correctional facilities. Several teams completed the opening stage with perfect scores before advancing to the championship rounds.

Sørås Super-Blitz Oktober 2026
rubriker._rss_content: Søråshøgda Sjakklubb i Bergen arrangerte Sørås Super-Blitz Oktober onsdag 14. oktober 2026. Det var 21 deltakere som spilte 9 runder lynsjakk. A-gruppen ble vunnet av den høyest ratede, Erland Foshaug, med 7½ poeng. På de neste plassene fulgte Martin Orvedal og Liam Stenstrand med 6 poeng. rubriker.title: ¿Qué dijo y qué omitió Karpov sobre el declive del ajedrez ruso?
rubriker._rss_content: El declive reciente del ajedrez ruso ha abierto un debate sobre sus causas estructurales y políticas. A partir de declaraciones de Anatoli Kárpov, el texto examina la pérdida de peso competitivo de Rusia, la erosión de la antigua escuela soviética y la falta de apoyo institucional. Al mismo tiempo, plantea una omisión relevante: el impacto de la guerra en Ucrania sobre el aislamiento, la emigración de jugadores y la participación internacional. | Foto: Sport24
